parameters.help_en: The ID of the database. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.name: db_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the database is a logical database. Valid values:

true: The database is a physical database.
false: The database is a logical database
parameters.help_zh:
数据库是逻辑库，取值：
true：物理库。
false：逻辑库
parameters.name: is_logic

parameters.help_en:
The name of the database. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188103.html operation to obtain the database name.



If the database is a physical database, you can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html operation to obtain the database name.

If the database is a logical database, you can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141874.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html operation to obtain the name of the database
parameters.help_zh:
数据库名，可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188103.html接口获取该参数的值。
物理库名：您还可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html接口获取该参数的值。
逻辑库名：您还可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141874.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: schema_name

parameters.help_en:
The name of the table. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188103.html operation to obtain the table name.

You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141878.html operation to obtain the table name
parameters.help_zh:
表名，可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188103.html接口获取该参数的值。

parameters.name: table_name

parameters.help_en:
The name of the field. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188103.html operation to obtain the field name.

You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141870.html operation to obtain the field name
parameters.help_zh:
字段名，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188103.html接口获取该参数的值。

parameters.name: column_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the masking rule
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to reset the masking rule. Valid value:

true: Reset the masking rule.
false: Do not reset the masking rule. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
是否重置脱敏规则。取值：
true：重置脱敏规则。
false（默认）：不重置脱敏规则
parameters.name: is_reset

parameters.help_en:
The desensitization algorithm of the field setting. The default value is false. The values are as follows:

true: default desensitization algorithm.

false :semi-desensitization algorithm
parameters.help_zh:
字段设置的脱敏算法，默认值为false。取值如下：

true：默认的脱敏算法。
false：半脱敏算法
parameters.name: is_default

parameters.help_en:

租户ID。
